grades: Rising high school seniors (finished grade 11, at least one semester left)
name: Maryland Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Maryland
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Delegates run for city and state office. They take part in a political simulation. They hear from real leaders. There are college prep sessions too.
who_can_apply: Boys who have finished their junior year of high school by the start of the session, in public, private or home school, with at least one semester left. You cannot have attended any other Boys State.
pay_detail: Free. The FAQ says there is no cost to the student or family. Sponsors such as American Legion posts pay.
duration: One week. The 2027 session is June 20 to 26, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 26, 2027 at McDaniel College. The 2026 application ran Nov 15, 2025 to May 1, 2026. The 2027 application dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply online using the Apply now link on the Maryland Boys & Girls State site. Accepted students usually hear back in 2 to 3 weeks.
notes: Students under 17 sleep in college dorms, usually two to a room. Phones, smartphones and smartwatches are not allowed. The site recommends against driving yourself because the week is tiring. Staff are mostly veterans.
